run_create_dataset_cli: run the CLI to process raw JSON replays into train/val/dev datasets with instruction dictionary
create_dataset_from_files: create a dataset by loading JSON game files and applying label, filter, and prev-instruction preprocessing
label_all_cont_frames: label each game frame with glob_cont flag when all units have no new target command
filter_beginning_cont_frames: filter leading continuation frames from each instruction segment in a game replay
split_train_val_files: split a list of JSON file paths into train and validation sets using a random seed and ratio
